title: Unit Review: Contrast and Restriction, and Da Cunha
goal: Review the contrast and restriction markers through a text about Euclides da Cunha and Los sertones.
grammar: review of the contrast and restriction markers, and a text about Euclides da Cunha and Los sertones

items: I can read a short text about Euclides da Cunha and his book Los sertones.
I can choose the marker that fits the kind of contrast or limit.
I can replace one idea with another using *sino* and *en vez de*.
